newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash January wheat firms on exports.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash January wheat firms on exports.

text.p: Argentine cash January wheat firmed in tight trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with buying fueled by the healthy FOB market, traders said.

Cash April maize firmed lazily on the back of a stronger Chicago, but supply was scant and volume thin. Spot maize was steady in a market devoid of interested buyers. Cash soybeans were steady to slightly firmer, encouraged by the CBOT, but supply was short. Sunflower seed followed soybeans higher, assisted by firm oil prices. Volume was low.
